text:
rohan: quick heads up — int4-induction run shows a subtle but reproducible summary hallucination uptick on the longform promptset after the recent dedupe pass. can we triage?

ivy: how big is subtle? numbers?

rohan: on the 1k longform micro-golden slice: factual-error-rate up from 4.1% -> 7.6%. ROUGE-L drops ~2.4 points.

julia: is this only on longform or cross-encoder tasks too?

rohan: mostly longform abstractive summarization and instruction-chained examples where anchors depend on previous assistant assertions. short summaries unaffected.

sam (label-ops): pulling annotation history — we ran fuzzy-dedupe v3 last night and collapsed ~240 near-duplicates in the longform bank. many had slight context shifts.

ivy: could the quantization step (int4 kernel mapping) be amplifying small context differences introduced by dedupe?

rohan: possible. int4-induction uses a new activation clamp and altered attention scaling, which can change sensitivity to trailing prompts.

bench-bot: queued run: qbench-3794709999-int4-induction-diff. estimated 18m. details: https://ci.internal/runs/3794709999

julia: before we run full qbench, can we run a quick A/B on the micro-golden with and without the dedupe merges restored? i want to know if the merge is the main driver.

sam (label-ops): I can fork the longform-goldset to longform-goldset-restore_240 and unmerge those entries. gives us a clean compare.

rohan: please do. also add a tag metadata: provenance.pre_merge_sha so we can trace back.

sam (label-ops): will do. creating fork now. command: \n```\npython tools/goldset_fork.py --source longform-goldset --restore-ids restore-list.txt --out longform-goldset-restore_240\n```\n
ops-bot: goldset fork created: s3://goldsets/longform-goldset-restore_240 (size: 1.2GB)

ivy: run the int4 eval pinned to that fork and compare metrics for the micro-golden anchors only. we should gather token-level diffs and hallucination categories (invented-entity, wrong-date, wrong-fact).

rohan: adding: please run with metrics: rouge_l, factual_error_rate_by_type, perplexity, and span_overlap.

bench-bot: CI queued: qbench-3794709999-int4-restore. link: https://ci.internal/runs/3794710012

julia: also add a quick check: sample pairs where merged version removed a trailing line starting with "Context:" — those often carry the disambig for the summary.

sam (label-ops): extracted 86 anchors with trailing-context markers. pushing list to review queue.

rohan: if the restore run brings the factual-error-rate back down ~baseline, then the dedupe was the likely root cause. if not, we need to blame quantization changes.

bench-bot: qbench-3794709999-int4-restore complete. micro-golden results: factual_error_rate increased 0.6% vs baseline when restored; with merge applied it was +3.5%.

ivy: that suggests the merge caused most of the delta. good to know.

julia: next step: add dedupe pipeline guardrails for "context-salient" markers. we should also mark these anchors golden.keep_context = true to prevent auto-collapse.

sam (label-ops): I'll add a golden flag and backfill the 86 anchors. I'll also enqueue 2-reviewer confirmation for the full 240. estimated time: 48h for top-100, 96h for remainder.

rohan: for the model onboarding side, let's add a canary gate: any quantized bring-up must pass a micro-golden context-sensitive diff with threshold factual_error_rate_delta <= 1.0% OR we abort the rollout.

ivy: agreed. i'll update the onboarding playbook and add the gate in the rollout CI job.

julia: small ops ask: can we snapshot the dedupe commit and goldset shards for auditability? add provenance entry in release notes.

ops-bot: snapshot created: repo@commit:3f9a2e6; goldset_s3: s3://goldsets/snapshots/3794709999-3f9a2e6.tar.gz

sam (label-ops): opened PR on dedupe: skip_merge if metadata.context_salient == true OR golden_flag == true. adding unit tests and an e2e smoke that runs the micro-golden diff. PR: https://git.internal/p/dedupe/pull/182

rohan: excellent. let's hold int4-induction canary until PR is merged and the gate is enabled. ivY will you coordinate the release hold?

ivy: yep, flagging the canary in the release board and notifying infra. :no_entry_sign:

julia: one last thing — we should add a small promptset for onboarding that intentionally includes "context-salient" edgecases so future quant experiments exercise this dimension automatically.

rohan: +1. sam can you create a 200-sample challenge set and add it to the qbench baseline?

sam (label-ops): on it. creating challenge set: longform-context-challenge-200. will seed from the 86 confirmed anchors plus 114 curated by QA.

bench-bot: note: add longform-context-challenge-200 to default onboarding qbench for quantized models.

ivy: thanks all — good catch. we'll avoid a bad rollout. :raised_hands:
